Reference / runtime/host_crypto

runtime/host_crypto#

The native layer under crypto/error, digest/host: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under crypto/error, digest/host: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Private substrate for digest/* and crypto/*: reviewed host implementations (RustCrypto and, for RSA, aws-lc in okkama-native) behind one byte-in/byte-out operation and cloneable digest states. Integers travel as decimal ASCII. Failures are NativeFailure in domain core.crypto: invalid_input (bad lengths, keys, parameters), permission_denied (authentication failed), unsupported, unexpected. Public modules wrap every call in typed objects and errors.
